name: sender_name
description: Display name of the email sender

name: sender_email
description: Normalized email address of the sender

name: snippet
description: Brief text snippet preview from Gmail

name: body_plain
description: Sanitized plain text message body without tracking scripts or raw HTML

name: internal_date
description: Internal Gmail delivery timestamp (used for time-partitioning)

name: labels
description: Array of Gmail labels applied (e.g. INBOX, UNREAD, CATEGORY_PROMOTIONS)

name: has_attachments
description: True if message contains non-inline file attachments

name: list_unsubscribe_url
description: Extracted one-click unsubscribe URL or mailto from List-Unsubscribe header

name: category
description: Inferred category (Personal, Work, Newsletters, Finance/Bills, Promotions, System)

name: inserted_at
description: Timestamp when record was inserted into BigQuery
